answer:
I have not stopped anything. query_aap2 can only read jobs; it has no cancel action. Cancel 512937 or 512944 from the controller UI if that is what you want.

Job 512944 failed at "Create the CloudFormation stack" with AlreadyExistsException: "Stack [iot-fleet-sim-h8cuy] already exists". The stack existed because another provision for the same GUID was already building it. find_jobs on west for h8cuy returns 2 provision jobs:
- 512937 (h8cuy-1-provision), started 2026-10-07T14:18:45Z and still running;
- 512944 (h8cuy-2-provision), started 2026-10-07T14:21:10Z, which failed about three minutes later.

So h8cuy was ordered (or launched) twice within a few minutes. In agnosticd/agnosticd-v2:ansible/configs/iot-fleet-sim/default_vars_ec2.yml the stack name is `stack_name: "{{ env_type }}-{{ guid }}"`. It is built from the GUID alone, so two runs for one GUID always collide on the same stack. The second run lost the race. The first run, 512937, owns the stack and is still provisioning it; it is the one to keep. The template itself is fine.
